requirements.text: Implement push notifications for every transaction, including details like the amount spent, the merchant name, and remaining balance.
Provide personalized budgeting tools that allow users to set monthly budgets for various categories and receive automated monthly spending breakdowns.
Create a guided walkthrough for users to set up their budgets, allowing customization and providing suggestions based on historical spending.
Introduce biometric login options such as fingerprint and facial recognition for account access.
Allow users to freeze and unfreeze their debit or credit cards instantly through the app.
Enable users to set daily, weekly, or monthly spending limits on their cards.
Provide transaction notifications for any card activity over a user-defined amount.
Allow users to request a replacement card directly through the app.
Implement merchant controls that allow users to restrict their cards for certain categories or merchants.
Ensure that new app features can be integrated within the constraints of the existing API of the legacy core banking system.
Ensure smooth data synchronization between the app and the core banking system to support real-time notifications and spending insights.
Maintain compliance with PSD2, GDPR, and Central Bank regulations for all new features.
Ensure backward compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months during the rollout of new features.
Optimize app performance to minimize downtime and latency during data processing.
